items.originalTitle: 'I felt sorry for Fred' - Horner on Ferrari team boss rumours
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner said he "felt sorry" for Fred Vasseur when speculation surfaced last month linking Horner to replacing the Ferrari Formula 1 team principal.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，上月有关他可能接替法拉利F1车队负责人弗雷德·瓦塞尔的传闻出现时，他为瓦塞尔"感到遗憾"。
霍纳接受《泰晤士报》采访的内容在9月法拉利主场蒙扎比赛前完成，他在采访中称法拉利是"F1最大的品牌"、"梦想"和"沉睡的巨人"，该采访发布后引发了霍纳可能接替瓦塞尔的传闻，而瓦塞尔在车队的位置此前一直受到审视。
这甚至促使法拉利召开了一场引人注目的新闻发布会，以平息猜测并公开表态对瓦塞尔有信心。
霍纳在参加《The Race F1 Podcast》节目时被问及与法拉利有关的传闻。
“这一切的时机非常不幸，”霍纳告诉《The Race》。
“我做了一次采访，他们当时正在连载这本书，采访我的是个非常友善的家伙，是刘易斯·汉密尔顿的忠实粉丝。他过来聊了聊，虽然不是这个行业的人，但他是这项运动的粉丝。
“他谈到了不同的车队等等。然后我们聊到了法拉利。法拉利和其他车队不一样。法拉利，你能看到车手和人们是如何高度推崇和尊重它的。我当时是想对法拉利表示尊重。
“这次采访大概是在实际发表前一个月做的。结果碰巧赶上了，我想，是围绕蒙扎或马德里或其他地方发表的一些评论。”
“突然出现了一个标题，在这篇文章上写着‘法拉利是我的梦想’。我其实从未说过那样的话。我是想表达法拉利在这项运动中有着独特的位置，任何为那支车队工作的人都会将其视为一种荣幸。尤其是，我猜想，如果你是一个意大利人的话。”
“突然间，它变成了一件实际上绝非意在给弗雷德施加任何形式压力的事情。但这个标题，加上他们那个世界和他们的车手所发生的一切，制造了这场小风波。”
“我为弗雷德感到难过，因为我曾在一支表现出色的车队、或一支高压车队的前沿工作过，知道其中涉及什么。”
“这只是一个二加二凑成六的问题。”
《泰晤士报》援引霍纳的话说：“我会考虑法拉利吗？我的意思是，法拉利是一级方程式赛车中最大的品牌。这是梦想。而且可以说是F1中沉睡的巨人。”
那么，如果霍纳获得合适的控制权，他真的会考虑法拉利的最高职位吗？
“法拉利在这项运动中就是法拉利，他们拥有巨大影响力的地位，”他说。“而且他们今年显然有一辆很棒的车，或者肯定是底盘；看起来他们在引擎动力上可能有点落后。我认为每个人都希望看到法拉利再次获胜。
“我可能更专注于其他选择。”
“每当你与法拉利联系在一起，那都是极大的荣誉，但这不是我主动去争取的事情。”
霍纳补充道：“我认为在任何组织中，稳定都是关键。”
“我在红牛任职期间，与大概六位、也许七位车队领队同桌而坐，从让·托德一直到弗雷德。”
“稳定至关重要。法拉利作为实质上的国家队，承受着其他车队不会面临的同等审视压力。”
“我认为，看到法拉利在这项运动中获胜会受到所有人的欢迎。我认为弗雷德是一位非常有能力的管理者，我认为他在低级别赛事中有着出色的履历。他可能只是需要更多时间。”
detailEn: Christian Horner said he "felt sorry" for Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur when speculation linking Horner to replacing him surfaced last month.

The release of an interview Horner conducted with The Times - which took place before Ferrari's tricky home race at Monza in September, and in which he called Ferrari "the biggest brand in Formula 1", "the dream" and a "sleeping giant" - sparked rumours of Horner being a potential candidate to replace Vasseur, whose role at the squad had been under scrutiny.
It even led to a remarkable Ferrari press conference to quash speculation and publicly declare its confidence in Vasseur.
Horner was asked about the rumours linking him to joining Ferrari when he appeared on The Race F1 Podcast.
"The timing of it all was very unfortunate," Horner told The Race.
"I did an interview where they were serialising the book with a very pleasant chap, that was a big Lewis Hamilton fan. He came and had a chat and wasn't from the industry, but was a fan of the sport.

"He was talking about different teams and so on. And we talked about Ferrari. And Ferrari is different to the other teams. Ferrari, you can see the way that drivers and people hold it in huge esteem and with huge respect. And I was trying to be respectful to Ferrari.
"This interview was done about probably a month in advance of when it actually came out. It happened to coincide, I think, with some comments that were made around Monza or Madrid or whatever.

"Suddenly there was a headline that ran on this article that was talking about, 'Ferrari is my dream'. I never actually said that. I was trying to say that Ferrari has its unique place in the sport, and anybody that works for that team would see it as a privilege. Particularly, I assume, if you're an Italian.

"Suddenly it turned into something that was actually not meant in any way to be putting any form of pressure on Fred. But this headline, together with whatever was happening in their world and their drivers, created this bit of a storm.
"I felt sorry for Fred because I've been at the front of a performing team, or a high-pressure team, and know what's involved.
"It was a question of just two and two coming together and adding up to six."
The Times quoted Horner as saying: "Would I consider Ferrari? I mean, Ferrari is the biggest brand in Formula 1. It’s the dream. And arguably it's the sleeping giant of Formula 1."
So would Horner actually consider the top job at Ferrari if he was given the right control?

"Ferrari is Ferrari in the sport and they have a position of huge influence," he said. "And they've obviously had a great car, this year, or certainly the chassis; it looks like they've perhaps been a bit behind on engine power. And I think everybody would love to see Ferrari win again.
"I'm perhaps more focused on other options.
"Whenever you're associated with Ferrari, it's a great honour, but it's not something that I'm petitioning for."
Horner added: "I think within any organisation, stability is key.
"During my time at Red Bull, I sat across the table with maybe six or maybe seven team principals, going back to Jean Todt up to Fred.
"Stability is crucial. Ferrari has a pressure with it, as essentially a national team, that others don't come under the same scrutiny.

"I think that it would be popular for everybody to see Ferrari winning in the sport. I think Fred is a very capable operator, I think he's got a great pedigree in lower forms of racing. He probably just needs more time."
keyPointsZh: 霍纳接受《泰晤士报》采访的内容在9月法拉利主场蒙扎比赛前完成，他在采访中称法拉利是"F1最大的品牌"、"梦想"和"沉睡的巨人"
相关传闻甚至促使法拉利召开新闻发布会，公开表态对瓦塞尔有信心
keyPointsEn: Horner's interview with The Times took place before Ferrari's home race at Monza in September, and in it he called Ferrari "the biggest brand in Formula 1", "the dream" and a "sleeping giant"
The rumours even led to a Ferrari press conference that publicly declared confidence in Vasseur

items.titleZh: 诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手
items.summaryZh: F1车手皮埃尔·加斯利、兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在新加坡进行了一场巨型UNO游戏对决。

media.altZh: 诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris suffers defeat to F1 rivals in hilarious UNO showdown
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手
兰多·诺里斯、奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和皮埃尔·加斯利在新加坡进行了一场巨型UNO游戏对决。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里、麦克拉伦、兰多·诺里斯、麦克拉伦。
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
一级方程式车手皮埃尔·加斯利、兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在一段视频中展开了一场超级大型的UNO游戏，该视频在不到一天的时间内迅速获得了超过32万的观看次数。
一级方程式在YouTube上发布了这段视频，描述了“麦克拉伦组合”与皮埃尔·加斯利一起在维修区进行了一场超级大型的UNO游戏。
牌的大小大约和标牌一样，游戏开始时要求车手们洗牌。
“哦我的天，它们实际上也很重，”皮亚斯特里在队友观看时说道。‘我不希望伤到自己，’诺里斯开玩笑地说，同时他看着澳大利亚人试图将牌分成几堆来洗牌。规则是标准的UNO，只是牌更大，抽到最大数字的人先手。轮到皮埃尔了。
很快就开始了垃圾话。“别看我的牌了，伙计，”加斯利笑着，车手们在整个游戏过程中互相盯着对方的大手。
加斯利在得到诺里斯的+4之后，首先用完了他的牌，而那些像木瓜一样颜色的车手们开始联合起来对抗他们的阿尔卑斯竞争对手。他很快就结束了游戏，留下两位麦凯轮车手去争夺胜利。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂，麦凯轮，兰多·诺里斯，麦凯轮
“好吧，现在是我对奥斯卡了，”这位现任冠军说。“我们都输了，所以我并不在乎，”皮亚斯蒂补充道。
诺里斯拿着一大堆牌，挣扎着玩，甚至不小心用一张牌打到了自己的脸上。‘他手里有一半的牌，却还是不会玩，’加斯利在皮亚斯特里被迫拿走几张牌后开玩笑说，随着麦凯轮车手再次被迫拿走更多牌，他最终开玩笑地将自己的牌摔到了地上。
然而，游戏很快发生了变化。皮亚斯特里与加斯利合作，成功减少了手中的牌，最终游戏结束时，诺里斯手里拿着牌。
“这是我一生中第一次输的UNO游戏，”他说。
比赛结束后，问车手们对游戏的看法。‘我认为在某些时候，由于牌太多，这是一项两个人的工作，’皮亚斯特里说。‘你需要扔几个……’
“没有太多争议。通常在我家里，圣诞节过得并不太好，”加斯利承认。
本周末的美国大奖赛，诺里斯和皮亚斯特里占据了上风。诺里斯在车手积分榜上以201分排名第六，皮亚斯特里以138分排名第七，而加斯利以41分排名第十，代表阿尔派车队。
detailEn: Lando Norris suffers defeat to F1 rivals in hilarious UNO showdown
Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri and Pierre Gasly took on a giant game of UNO in Singapore
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Formula 1 drivers Pierre Gasly, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri went head to head at a super-sized game of UNO in a video that has quickly racked up more than 320,000 views in less than a day.
Formula 1 posted the clip on YouTube, describing it as “the McLaren duo” being “joined by Pierre Gasly for a game of super-sized UNO in the paddock”.
The cards were roughly the size of a sign board, and the game started with the drivers being asked to shuffle the deck.

“Oh my god, they’re actually heavy as well," Piastri said as his team-mate watched on. "I don’t want to injure myself,” Norris joked as he laughed at the Australian's attempt at separating the cards into piles to shuffle. The rules were standard UNO, just with “extra big cards”, and whoever drew the highest number went first. Enter Pierre.
It did not take long for the trash talk to start. “Stop looking at my cards, man,” Gasly laughed, with the drivers peering at each other’s oversized hands throughout the game.

Gasly got down to his last card first after he got Norris with a +4 and the papaya-coloured drivers were starting to team up against their Alpine competitor. He finished it off soon after, leaving the two McLaren drivers to fight it out.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
“OK, so it’s me against Oscar now,” the reigning champion said. “We’ve both lost, so I don’t really care," Piastri added.

Norris, holding a huge pile of cards, struggled to play, with him even managing to hit himself in the face with one. “He’s got half the deck in his hand and still can’t play,” Gasly joked after Piastri was forced to pick up several cards, with the McLaren driver eventually jokingly slamming his cards to the floor as he was once again forced to pick up more.
The game quickly changed, however. Piastri, teaming up with Gasly, was able to whittle his hand down and eventually Norris was the one holding cards as the game ended.
“That’s the first ever UNO game I’ve lost in my life,” he said.
The drivers were asked what they thought following the game. “I think it’s a two-person job at some points with so many cards,” Piastri said. “You need to Frisbee a few..."
“Not much argument. Usually with my family it goes down pretty badly over Christmas,” Gasly admitted.

This weekend at the United States Grand Prix, it is Norris and Piastri who hold the upper hand. Norris is sixth in the championship on 201 points and Piastri seventh on 138, while Gasly is 10th on 41 for Alpine.

items.originalTitle: Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆 The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Man...
items.summaryEn:
Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆
The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Manufacturers’ Championship set to be replaced by two new titles:
The FIA WRC Constructors’ Championship: Constructors must compete in every round of the season to be eligible for the title 🌏
WRC Teams’ Championship: Contested over seven nominated events, including a compulsory overseas round and the season finale 👀
Both championships will be exclusive to the Rally1 category 🔥
#FIA #WRC

items.summaryEn:
Two specifications. One top category. 🔥
For the 2027 and 2028 seasons, the FIA World Rally Championship’s Rally1 category will comprise two types of cars:
🚗 WRC Cars: Next-generation rally cars built to the FIA’s new technical regulations.
🚗WRC Kit Cars: Existing Rally2 cars fitted with an FIA-approved aerodynamic upgrade kit.
Both specifications will compete together in the Rally1 category, with an increased turbo restrictor diameter delivering approximately 15hp of additional power.
#FIA #WRC
detailZh:
两种规格。一个顶级类别。🔥
在2027年和2028赛季，国际汽联世界拉力锦标赛的Rally1类别将包括两种类型的赛车：
🚗WRC赛车：按照国际汽联的新技术规定建造的下一代拉力赛车。
🚗WRC套件赛车：现有的Rally2赛车配备国际汽联批准的空气动力学升级套件。
这两种规格将在Rally1类别中共同竞争，通过增加涡轮限制器直径，提供大约15马力的额外动力。
#FIA #WRC
detailEn:
Two specifications. One top category. 🔥
For the 2027 and 2028 seasons, the FIA World Rally Championship’s Rally1 category will comprise two types of cars:
🚗 WRC Cars: Next-generation rally cars built to the FIA’s new technical regulations.
🚗WRC Kit Cars: Existing Rally2 cars fitted with an FIA-approved aerodynamic upgrade kit.
Both specifications will compete together in the Rally1 category, with an increased turbo restrictor diameter delivering approximately 15hp of additional power.
#FIA #WRC

items.titleZh: 加里·安德森：红牛与梅赛德斯真正的区别细节
items.summaryZh: 红牛在最近的连续三站赛事中取代了梅赛德斯，成为F1的主导力量。那么，两辆赛车之间的真正区别是什么？

media.altZh: 加里·安德森：红牛与梅赛德斯真正的区别细节 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Gary Anderson: The details that really separate Red Bull and Mercedes
detailZh: 红牛在最近的连续三站赛事中取代了梅赛德斯，成为F1的主导力量。那么，两辆赛车之间的真正区别是什么？
随着F1规则的发展，我常常 wonder 设计和研究领域的成千上万的非常聪明的人可以带来什么新技术到外面的世界。是的，这样的机会一直有限，因为F1汽车上的部件一直太贵，无法直接转移到路上汽车上，但利用它们并证明它们的价值的灵感一直存在。
如果Colin Chapman用他的地面效应汽车，Gordon Murray用他的驾驶员躺下概念，风扇车和加油，或者Derek Gardner用他的六轮Tyrrell，如果他们坐下来准备新赛季，他们会如何看待当前的缺乏创新、严厉、过度规定的规则？
尽管如此，我们仍然看到车队提出的不同之处。没有重大的视觉概念差异，但正如常说的那样，魔鬼在细节中，而这些细节确实带来了收益。
现在，车队们不再追求秒或甚至十分之一秒的进步，而是寻求百分之一秒的提升。对于引入开发套件所付出的所有努力，这样的微小回报很难真正确定你是否取得了进步、停滞不前，或者实际上退步了。
这就是梅赛德斯目前所处的境地。从赛季开始就占据主导地位，并且是遥遥领先的车队，却遭遇了挫折。它在马来西亚引入的开发套件让它感到困惑。是的，数据显示一切都在向积极方向发展，但车手们发现赛车更加难以驾驶，因此也更难从中稳定地提取出圈速。
另一方面，红牛车队却采取了相反的策略。它从自己标准来看几乎灾难性的开局，到占据杆位并赢得最后三场比赛。是的，其中一场是冲刺赛，正如马克斯·维斯塔潘所说，这并不真正算数，但即便如此，这也仅仅表明，在引入开发的时候，任何硬币都有两面，只有一面（或者说一面会）取得成功。
从领先位置开始，让我们比较一下红牛和梅赛德斯。
梅赛德斯和阿斯顿·马丁据我所知是唯一两个在赛季开始时就将前翼安装在第二个元素上的车队（用红色椭圆突出显示）。这意味着在直线模式下，只有第三个元素（橙色高亮箭头）的角度被减小。
总的来说，这个概念可能节省了一些重量，但总的来说，它意味着前翼元素更多地是一个流向优化器，而不是一个主要的下压力产生装置。我这么说是因为第一和第二个元素之间的槽口距离机翼下表面最低气压区域相当近。这个低气压会产生下压力，基本上它会把车拉向赛道。在梅赛德斯的概念中，它将简单地通过那个槽口拉过更多的气流。
我们可以看到，三个元素和弦长度的差异并不大：前翼用浅蓝色箭头突出显示，中间用绿色箭头突出显示，后翼用橙色箭头突出显示。它们的弦长也相当恒定。
红牛、法拉利和麦克拉伦都选择了另一种方法：一个更长的弦长主平面，用深蓝色箭头突出显示。在直线模式下，他们减小了第二个和第三个元素的角度。
我将那根深蓝色的箭头转移到梅赛德斯的前翼上，以展示我对前翼第一元素和第二元素之间缝隙的理解，这个缝隙正好位于其两个前翼元素的总弦长度的中间。
第二和第三元素的弦长，用绿色和橙色箭头突出显示，向外增加。这意味着在船体内部和下方，气流方向变化更少，这里的目的是将最佳和最快的空气质量流引导到地板前缘。
此外，在红牛赛车中，尾翼边缘的细节比梅赛德斯更为复杂。这应该会减少在制动时车辆前部接近地面、在转弯中滚动和转弯出弯时，当翼片的外部部分越过出口边缘时的敏感性。
接下来是地板中央部分的尖端，红牛的地板安装系统（绿色突出显示）基本上将车辆分成两部分。在该安装系统的中间还设置了一个小叶片（紫色突出显示），以帮助整理从前翼中央部分流出的气流。
导流板和地板板区域相似，但实际上在处理它试图管理的气流方面却相当不同。
总的来说，元素的数量相似。然而，红牛似乎在尝试做更多的事情来整理前轮胎的湍流（尾流）。由于F1是一个开放式轮子公式，管理轮胎周围的气流，无论是前轮还是后轮，对于汽车的整体空气动力学性能至关重要。
此外，轮子阻塞可能占汽车阻力的约40%。
当汽车穿过空气时，它必须移除大量的空气。被移除的空气试图填充轮胎后面的空隙，因此管理它并确保它不会对其他产生下压力的设备产生不利影响，基本上就是导流板和地板板区域的作用。红牛正在做更多的事情来尝试在它能够从地板脚板产生下压力之前管理那种湍流，实际上就是地板的前角。
与现在大多数车队所采用的简单下洗侧箱不同，红牛车队保留了抬高的外箱部分，给它带来了一个类似内沟，其侧视图与梅赛德斯侧箱非常相似。
这是为了帮助管理侧箱上的气流并进入变速箱两侧的中央区域，而不是仅仅在油桶区域的整个宽度上产生更多的气流。这样做可以改善扩散器在中央部分最需要改进的地方的性能。
红牛车队似乎在这里实施了一个颇具争议的策略，它有一个非常尖锐的尾缘，红色高光线在这里转为白色。
规则定义了侧箱上角允许的最小半径。大多数车队只是选择这些最小半径，但任何规则都关乎寻找任何灰色地带。通过拥有这个更尖锐的角半径，当来自上侧箱内沟和外侧箱表面的气流汇合时，它将以不同的速度移动，所以基本上沿着那个尖锐的角，它将产生一个涡流，如果正确集中，将沿着后刹车管道的内侧移动，从而在那些刹车管道上安装的转向叶片上产生更高的下压力，进而改善扩散器的性能。
黄色高亮线基本上是梅赛德斯侧箱的侧面轮廓。
我们现在转向后轮胎接触面前面的区域。这同样涉及到管理后轮胎周围的气流，尤其是轮胎接触面区域。
当轮胎在赛道表面上旋转时，你会得到所谓的轮胎喷溅。它既向内又向外。向外，你基本上可以任其自由行动，但向内的轮胎喷溅可能会对扩散器的性能产生不利影响，进而影响整个底板。
这个区域的细节和理念相当相似。红牛的通风系统似乎更靠前，正如你从地板下面的槽口阴影中可以看到的，槽口自然地引导到后轮胎接触面的内侧。
尽管这些是连接地面和车顶的凹槽，但目标实际上是减少从车顶流到底下的溢出物。它们通过将轮胎接触点后方的空腔与轮胎喷射的高能量连接起来，起到密封系统的作用。反过来，通常由于车底低气压而被吸到车底下的气流，现在也被吸到轮胎接触点周围。
扩散器不再是简单的斜坡连接到矩形出口区域的时代已经过去了；现在它是由多个叶片和有策略地放置的开口组成。不想批评梅赛德斯，但红牛的系统似乎在元素细节上更胜一筹。至于梅赛德斯，我还会质疑其内部延伸部分，它将扩散器的后缘连接到翼片，如果可以这么称呼的话，用紫色突出显示。
扩散器的这个内部部分距离来自其他任何组件的气流结构影响最远，因此在这个区域最大化性能可能会很有吸引力。然而，当汽车接近地面或环境温度和/或赛道温度升高时，该区域的气流会变得有些懒散。
当这种情况发生时，很容易诱导气流分离，尤其是在内部垂直表面和扩散器上表面的接合处。
法拉利是第一个引入排气出口斜坡的车队。在许多关于它如何在规定范围内通过其差速器位置实现这一点的讨论之后，其他大多数车队也或多或少地实现了相同的解决方案。基本上，规定要求排气出口的最小尺寸。它必须是圆形的，出口角度也是定义好的，所有这些都是为了减少排气吹拂的可能性。
然而，有志者事竟成。其中一个论点是，规定中没有控制安装支架。无论什么理由，目标都是一样的：在排气出口后面放置某个东西只是将排气流向上方，由于排气出口的一部分被封闭，它增加了其速度。
在全油门和转弯出口时，这两个因素都会改善后翼的尾部下压力，以及我之前提到的那个中央扩散器区域的一致性，该区域之前出现过分离问题。
很多时候我说细节决定成败，所以你可以说，梅赛德斯的双元素叶片应该比红牛的单元素版本要好一些，但在这个案例中，我认为这并不重要。基本上，它是一个改变非常不稳定和湍流排气气流速度和方向的封闭塞，因此添加这个组件做了大部分的工作，优化细节只会带来非常小的回报。
如果我是国际汽联决策小组的一员，我会在一开始就禁止它。理由是，你无法看到所需的开阔空间，它没有达到所需的圆形，并且最后一部分没有在所需的范围内。
坦白地说，我并不是说哪一个方案比另一个更好。得出这个结论需要无数小时的头脑风暴和风洞以及CFD的空气动力学测试。我需要的不仅仅是让我的耳朵分开的东西，而是需要几百（个）其他的贡献。
这主要是为了展示从非常具体的规定中可以产生多大的差异。是的，这些规定不允许你重新发明轮子，但它们仍然允许你在知道什么是最优的，或者希望是最优的之前进行一些思考。
detailEn: Red Bull has taken over from Mercedes as Formula 1’s dominant force, based on what we saw in the recent triple-header. So what’s made the difference between the two cars?

With the way F1 regulations are going, I often wonder what new technologies the thousands of very clever people who work in the design and research areas of these teams can bring to the big world outside. Yes, the opportunity for that has always been limited, as parts on an F1 car have always been much too expensive to transfer directly to road cars, but the inspiration to exploit them and prove their worth has always been there.

What would Colin Chapman with his ground-effect cars, Gordon Murray with his driver-lying-down concept, fan car and refuelling, or Derek Gardner with his six-wheeled Tyrrell think of the current uninventive, draconian, overly-prescriptive regulations if they were sitting down to sharpen their pencils in preparation for the new season?

All that said, we still see differences between what the teams come up with. There are no major visual concept differences, but as is often said, the devil is in the detail, and that detail really does pay dividends.

Now, instead of seconds or even tenths of a second of improvement, the teams are looking for hundredths of a second. With this small return for all the effort of introducing a development package, it is difficult to really be sure if you have moved forward, stood still or actually gone backwards.

This is where Mercedes finds itself at the moment. The dominant team from the start of the season and a runaway championship contender has stumbled. Its development package introduced in Malaysia has confused it. Yes, it says the numbers all add up to a positive, but the drivers are finding the car more difficult and, with that, finding it harder to consistently extract the laptime from it.

On the other hand, Red Bull has done the opposite. It has come from a more or less disastrous start by its standards to be on pole and win the last three races. Yes, one was a sprint, which, as Max Verstappen said, doesn’t really count, but even so, it just shows that when it comes to introducing developments, there are two sides to any coin and only one (or should I say won) will come up trumps.
Starting at the front, let’s compare the Red Bull and Mercedes.

Mercedes and Aston Martin were, as far as I am aware, the only two teams to start the season with the front wing mounted on the second element (highlighted with the red ellipse). This meant that, for straight mode, only the third element (orange highlight arrow) was reduced in angle.

Overall, there is probably a small weight saving with this concept, but in general it has meant that the forward element is more of a flow-direction optimiser as opposed to a major downforce-producing device. I say that because the slot gap between the first and second elements is fairly close to where the lowest air pressure is on the wing’s underside. This low pressure creates downforce, basically it pulls the car towards the track. On the Mercedes concept, it will simply pull more airflow through that slot gap.

We can see here that the chord lengths of the three elements are not vastly different: forward highlighted with the light blue arrow, middle with the green arrow, rear with the orange arrow. They are also fairly constant in chord along their span.

Red Bull, Ferrari and McLaren have all gone for the other approach: a much longer-chord mainplane, highlighted with the dark blue arrows. When in straight mode, they reduce the angle of both the second and third elements.

I have transposed that dark blue arrow onto the Mercedes front wing to show what I mean about the slot gap between the forward element and the second element being slap bang in the middle of the total chord length of its two forward elements.

The chord lengths of the second and third elements, highlighted with the green and orange arrows, increase going outwards. This means that there is less airflow direction change inboard and under the chassis, where the objective is to get the best and fastest mass airflow to the leading edge of the underfloor.

Also, on the Red Bull, the detail of the trailing edge of the endplates is more sophisticated than on the Mercedes. This should reduce the sensitivity when the front of the car is close to the ground under braking, in roll mid-corner and on corner exit when the outer part of the wing runs over the exit kerbs.

Moving on to the leading edge of the central section of the floor, the Red Bull floor mounting system (green highlight) basically splits the car into two halves. It also has a small vane (purple highlight) halfway up that mounting system to help tidy up the airflow coming off the central section of the front wing.
The bargeboard and floor plate area is similar but actually fairly different in how it treats the airflow that it is trying to manage.

Overall, there are a similar number of elements. However, Red Bull looks as though it is doing more to attempt to tidy up the front tyre turbulence (wake). F1 being an open-wheel formula, managing the airflow around the tyres, both front and rear, is critical to the car’s overall aerodynamic performance.
Also, the wheel blockage probably accounts for something like 40% of the car’s drag.

As the car passes through the air, it has to displace a serious volume of air. That displaced air tries to fill the void behind the tyres, so managing it and making sure it doesn’t detrimentally affect the other downforce-producing devices is basically what this bargeboard and floor plate area is about. Red Bull is doing more to attempt to manage that turbulence before it does what it can to generate downforce from the floor footplate, in effect the front corner of the floor.

Instead of having a simple downwash sidepod as most teams now have, Red Bull has retained the raised outer section, giving it a gully inboard which is very similar in profile to the Mercedes sidepod in side view.

This is to help manage the airflow over the sidepods and into that central area around the sides of the gearbox, as opposed to just generating more flow through the complete width of the coke bottle area. Doing this can improve the diffuser’s performance where it struggles most, in its central section.
Red Bull also seems to have pulled off something of a controversial coup here, in that it has a very sharp trailing edge where the red highlight line turns to white.

The regulations define the minimum radii allowed on the sidepod’s upper corners. Most teams simply go for those minimum radii but with any regulation, it is about finding any grey areas. By having this sharper corner radius, as the airflow from the upper sidepod gully and the outer sidepod surface joins up, it will be travelling at different speeds, so basically along that sharp corner it will instigate a vortex which concentrated correctly, will travel along the inside of the rear brake ducts, generating higher levels of downforce on the turning vanes that are mounted on those brake ducts and in turn improve the performance of the diffuser.
The yellow highlight line is basically the Mercedes sidepod’s side profile.
We now move on to the area in front of the rear tyre contact patch. This is again about managing the airflow around the rear tyre, especially the tyre’s contact patch area.

As the tyre rotates on the track surface, you get what’s called tyre squirt. It goes both inboard and outboard. Outboard, you can basically let it do what it wants to do, but inboard tyre squirt can be detrimental to the performance of the diffuser and, in turn, the complete underfloor.

The detail and the philosophy in this area are quite similar. The Red Bull vent system seems to be further forward and, as you can see from the slot shadows on the ground below the floor, the slots lead naturally to the inside of the rear tyre contact patch.

Even though these are slots in the floor connecting the top surface to the underside, the objective is to actually reduce the spillage from the top surface going underneath the car. They act like a sealing system by connecting that fairly high-energy tyre squirt to the void behind the tyre’s contact patch. In turn, that airflow that would normally be pulled underneath the car by the low pressure on its underside is also pulled around the tyre contact patch.

Gone are the days when the diffuser was a simple ramp to a rectangular exit area; now it’s a multitude of vanes with strategically placed openings. Not to criticise Mercedes, but the Red Bull system seems to have just that little bit more detail to its elements. The other thing I would question on the Mercedes is the inner extension that connects the trailing edge of the diffuser to the beam wing, if it can be called that, highlighted in purple.

This inner section of the diffuser is furthest away from any influence from airflow structures coming from any other components, and because of that it can be tempting to maximise the performance in that area. However, when the car is close to the ground or the ambient and/or track temperature increases, the airflow in that area gets a bit lazy.
When that happens, it’s very easy to induce airflow separation, especially along the junction of the inner vertical surface and the diffuser’s upper surface.

Ferrari was the first to introduce the exhaust exit ramp. After many column inches about how it had managed this within the regulations only because of its differential position, most of the other teams have achieved more or less the same solution. Basically, the regulations call for an exhaust outlet of a minimum size. It has to be round, and the exit angle is also defined, all of which is to reduce the potential for exhaust blowing.

However, where there is a will, there is a way. One of the arguments was that mounting brackets weren’t controlled in the regulations. Whatever the reasoning, the objective is the same: having something behind the exhaust outlet simply redirects the exhaust flow upwards and, as part of the exhaust outlet is blanked off, it increases its velocity.

On full throttle and at reasonably high revs on corner exit, both of these will improve the rear downforce from the rear wing and consistency in that central section of the diffuser that I spoke about suffering from separation problems earlier.

Many times I say the devil is in the detail, so I suppose you could say that the twin element vane on the Mercedes should be a little better than the single element version on the Red Bull, but in this case I don’t think it really matters. Basically, it is a blanking plug that alters the velocity and direction of the very inconsistent and turbulent exhaust gas flow, so adding the component does most of the heavy lifting and optimising the detail would give a very small return.

If I were part of the decision-making group at the FIA, I would have banned it from day one. The reasoning would be that you couldn’t see the required opening, it wasn’t round as required, and the last section wasn’t within the required angle.

To be honest and upfront, I’m not saying either package is better than the other. To reach that conclusion would require countless hours of head-scratching and aerodynamic testing in both the windtunnel and CFD. Instead of just what keeps my ears apart, I would need a few (hundred) others to contribute.

This is mainly to show just what differences you can get from a very prescriptive set of regulations. Yes, those regulations don’t allow you to reinvent the wheel, but they still allow for some grey-matter scratching before you know what’s best, or hopefully best.

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner: Building Red Bull’s F1 engine was “scary as hell”
items.summaryEn: Former Red Bull team principal Christian Horner has said building the team's in-house power unit from scratch was "scary as hell"; the engine has now taken its first race wins in the 2026 season, a year after Horner himself was removed from the team.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳：从零打造红牛F1引擎“可怕至极”
克里斯蒂安·霍纳回顾了将红牛与福特合作的引擎从“彻头彻尾的初创项目”带到首个赛季即赢得分站冠军的历程
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
前红牛车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，从零开始打造车队自研动力单元“可怕至极”；该引擎在2026赛季已取得首场分站胜利，而霍纳本人早在一年前已被红牛解职。
霍纳在2025年英国大奖赛后被解除米尔顿凯恩斯的职务。一连串糟糕的成绩和争议导致了这一刻，这位英国人最终被洛朗·梅基斯取代，后者当时正领导着姊妹车队小红牛。然而，在本田退出锦标赛后，霍纳一直负责红牛与福特的合作。
这款与福特合作的动力单元今年首次上赛道，此后被国际汽联标记为内燃机的标杆。马克斯·维斯塔潘也在雪邦为这款动力单元带来了首场胜利，并在新加坡再下一城。
伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，洛朗·梅基斯，红牛车队领队
在接受Motorsport.com采访时谈到他的动力总成胜利，他说：“这可以说是我在红牛时期面临的最大挑战，因为一切从零开始。那里什么都没有。[这是]一个完全的初创项目。看到那台引擎所达到的里程碑，建立制造设施、制造活塞、从实心块加工气缸，令人惊叹，投入到那个项目中的承诺。”
“那简直可怕极了，因为我们完全没有制造引擎的经验。”
他补充道：“看到那台引擎在它的第16场比赛、也就是第一年就赢得胜利，我为此深感自豪。我为团队的人们感到无比骄傲，为他们所做的一切和取得的成就感到骄傲，因为在许多方面，人们很容易低估从零开始打造一台引擎的挑战，尤其是在这项运动历史上最复杂的一套引擎规则之下，还要击败那些经验丰富得多的车队和制造商。”
这篇采访刊出之际，霍纳的回忆录《Drive》即将出版，他在书中还声称，在托托·沃尔夫接任之前，尼基·劳达曾试图聘请他担任梅赛德斯车队领队。
红牛前往奥斯汀时，在车队积分榜第三名的争夺中落后迈凯伦七分。
detailEn: Christian Horner: Building Red Bull’s F1 engine was “scary as hell”
Christian Horner reflects on taking Red Bull’s Ford-partnered engine from a “complete startup” to a race winner in its first season
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Former Red Bull team principal Christian Horner has admitted that building the team’s in-house power unit from scratch was “scary as hell”, after the engine claimed its first race wins this 2026 season. This comes despite him being axed from the team a year earlier.

Horner was removed from his position in Milton Keynes after the 2025 British Grand Prix. A bout of poor results and controversy led to this moment, with the Briton being eventually replaced by Laurent Mekies, who was, at the time, leading the Racing Bulls sister team. Horner, however, had been leading Red Bull’s partnership with Ford after Honda withdrew from the championship.

This Ford-partnered power unit hit the track for the first time this year and has since been labelled as the benchmark internal combustion engine by the FIA. Max Verstappen also gave the power unit its first win at Sepang, and another in Singapore.
Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal

Talking to Motorsport.com about his power train triumph, he said: “It was arguably the biggest challenge I had in my time at Red Bull, because it was from nothing. There was nothing there. [It was] a complete startup. To see the milestones that engine was achieving, producing [a] manufacturing facility, manufacturing pistons, machining cylinders out of solid blocks, it was amazing, the commitment that went into that project.
“It was scary as hell because we had no experience of building engines.”

He added: “The satisfaction of seeing that engine win in its 16th race in its first year, I take great pride in that. Tremendous pride in the people, what they have done and achieved, because in many respects it’s easy to underestimate the challenges of taking an engine from scratch, particularly within the most complex set of engine regulations in the history of the sport, and beating teams and manufacturers with so much more experience.”
The interview comes ahead of the release of Horner’s memoir, Drive, in which he also claims Niki Lauda tried to hire him as Mercedes team principal before Toto Wolff took the job.
Red Bull heads to Austin seven points behind McLaren in the battle for third in the constructors’ championship.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯何时能赢得2026年F1车队冠军？
梅赛德斯领先法拉利134分，但无法在奥斯汀独自创造决定性的差距
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里有最新的银箭消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车开发和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
梅赛德斯在2026年新规则下的新赛季起步强劲，但尽管其车手基米·安东内利理论上可以在即将到来的美国大奖赛上锁定他的F1冠军，但作为一支车队，梅赛德斯还需要等待一段时间才能确认其车队冠军。
墨西哥大奖赛是Brackley车队最早能够确认其车队冠军的时刻，如果它在奥斯汀进一步扩大领先优势。车队目前领先578分，领先法拉利134分。尽管还有六场比赛，但根据数据，迈凯轮和红牛仍然有可能赢得冠军，但这非常不现实。
从现在开始，一支车队在每个周末最多可以获得43分，最后的冲刺周末将在新加坡举行。这意味着整个赛季剩余部分共有258分可供争夺。在奥斯汀之后，还有215分可以争夺，这意味着即使梅赛德斯以1-2的成绩结束，而法拉利未能得分，这也会将其领先优势扩大到仅177分。因此，在德克萨斯州无法赢得冠军。
11月份将迎来墨西哥大奖赛，这将是梅赛德斯最早赢得冠军的机会。在那之后，还剩下四场比赛，剩余172分，因此梅赛德斯需要至少领先172分，通过在奥斯汀和墨西哥的比赛中比法拉利多38分来赢得冠军。
即使平局，也将指向梅赛德斯，因为梅赛德斯有11个大奖赛胜利，而法拉利只有两个。
两辆梅赛德斯车队获得了一二名，而法拉利在两个周末的比赛中最多只能获得48分，这将使它赢得胜利。这意味着圣保罗在11月8日成为更现实的选项。在巴西之后，将有129分可供争夺，如果梅赛德斯领先129分或更多，它将成为冠军。
要在拉斯维加斯获胜，车队需要领先86分，而要在11月底的卡塔尔锁定冠军，只需要领先43分。
显然，由于中东地区的局势，卡塔尔和阿布扎比仍然存在疑问，这些比赛是否会被取消将取决于可用的分数。伊莫拉也被讨论为可能的替代赛。
第九个车队冠军将使梅赛德斯与威廉姆斯持平，各有九个，落后于法拉利和麦克拉伦。它之前从2014年到2021年连续获得了八个冠军。
detailEn: How soon can Mercedes win the 2026 F1 constructors' championship?
Mercedes leads Ferrari by 134 points but cannot create a decisive gap in Austin alone
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Mercedes has had a dominant start to the new regulations in 2026, but while its driver Kimi Antonelli could technically seal his Formula 1 championship win this coming Sunday at the United States Grand Prix, Mercedes as a team will have to wait a little longer to confirm its constructors' championship.

The Mexican Grand Prix is the earliest the Brackley squad could confirm its constructors' championship win if it further extends its lead in Austin. The team leads on 578 points, 134 points clear of Ferrari. And with still six races left, McLaren and Red Bull could - by the numbers - still win it, but it is highly unrealistic.

A team can score a maximum of 43 points per weekend going forward with the last sprint weekend taking place in Singapore. That leaves a total of 258 points available in the rest of the season. After Austin, 215 points will still be up for grabs, meaning that even if Mercedes finishes with a 1-2 and Ferrari fails to score, this would extend its lead to just 177. Therefore, the title cannot be won in Texas.

The month of November brings a race in Mexico, and this will be Mercedes' earliest chance at winning its title. With just four races left after that, 172 points remain, so Mercedes needs a lead of at least 172 points by outscoring Ferrari by 38 points across both Austin and Mexico.
Even a tie would still point to Mercedes, with 11 grand prix wins to Ferrari's two.

Two Mercedes one-twos while Ferrari collects no more than 48 points across both weekends would hand it the win. This does mean Sao Paulo is the more realistic option on 8 November. With 129 points up for grabs after Brazil, Mercedes would be champion if it was 129 points or more ahead.
To win in Las Vegas, the team would need a lead of 86 and to clinch it in Qatar, at the end of November, would require a lead of just 43.

Obviously, with both Qatar and Abu Dhabi still in question due to the situation in the Middle East, fewer points could be available depending on whether these races could be cancelled. Imola has also been discussed as a possible replacement.
A ninth constructors’ title would take Mercedes level with Williams on nine, behind Ferrari and McLaren. Its previous eight came in a row from 2014 to 2021.

Results from both cars will count towards a single LMGT3 Teams' classification next year. Currently, each car in a two-car team scores points independently as a separate entry. The revised format places greater emphasis on overall team performance.
